subject: Issues with which.proteinid argument in MSstats::PDtoMSstatsFormat

messages.author: 213804ad0e79002c
messages.subject: Issues with which.proteinid argument in MSstats::PDtoMSstatsFormat
parts:
Hello again,

The default protein identifier in PDtoMSstatsFormat is an accession ID. In order to get more use out of the protein identifier in MSstats (4.2), i started merging the accession ID and the gene symbol to make a unique variable ('gene_accession') that I can understand better. Within the PDtoMSstatsFormat function i change the which.proteinid argument to 'gene_accession', but the output indicates that the function is still using just the accession ID. I'm sure I could just keep using the accession ID, then left_join a data frame with the gene symbols and other useful protein annotation columns but I wanted to make sure I wasn't horribly messing something up. I've attached a sample of the feature data (sample_df), annotation data, and the log output file from the PDtoMSstatsFormat function.

I appreciate the help,
Best,
Scott

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: Issues with which.proteinid argument in MSstats::PDtoMSstatsFormat
parts:
Hi,

IIRC, the options are limited in the current MSstats converters (we only allow pre-defined set of columns), but I can change so you can use a custom column. I will make this update on Github (dev) version of the package and let you know when it's ready to install.


Kind regards,
Mateusz
